name: United States
label: USA
title: Paid Ads Management for US Businesses
description: Remote Meta, TikTok and Google Ads management for US businesses. Audience research, creative testing and lead-quality reporting with Zainab Abdullah.
intro: Reach customers across the United States with a campaign scope built around the offer, the service area and the next step after the click. Zainab Abdullah provides remote paid advertising support for businesses that need a clear testing plan and useful reporting.
sections: Local demand or nationwide sales?

A local service business and a nationwide online store need different campaign structures. Your brief should identify the states or service areas you can actually serve, delivery restrictions and the action that makes someone a qualified customer. For local enquiries, the plan can distinguish calls, booked appointments and form submissions. For ecommerce, it can focus on completed orders and the economics of acquiring a customer.
Match the channel to the buying journey

Google Search can support a defined search intent, while Facebook, Instagram and TikTok can introduce an offer through creative. The starting channel depends on your product, existing demand, available creative and budget. The scope can include account review, keyword or audience research, ad copy and a controlled test plan. Adding more channels is a decision based on evidence and capacity.
Measure enquiries beyond the form

An inexpensive lead is useful only if it becomes a relevant conversation. Agree on how the sales team records qualified leads, booked calls and sales before interpreting acquisition costs. Tracking requirements, consent handling and any CRM handoff are reviewed during planning. Implementation work outside campaign management is scoped separately.
Working remotely across US time zones

Include your preferred US time zone, approval contact and available meeting hours in the brief. Reporting dates, USD media budgets and response expectations are agreed before launch. Management fees and platform advertising spend are separate. You keep ownership of your advertising accounts and approve the proposed scope.
questions: Do you have an office in the USA?
The service is delivered remotely. This page describes support for US businesses and does not represent a US office.
What should I prepare for a campaign review?

Share your website, target states or service area, customer profile, current channels and budget. If available, provide aggregate campaign and lead-quality reports after an engagement is agreed. Do not send passwords through the enquiry form.

name: Saudi Arabia
label: Saudi Arabia / KSA
title: Paid Ads Management for Saudi Businesses
description: Meta, TikTok and Google Ads support for Saudi Arabia. Plan audiences, Arabic and English creative approvals, SAR budgets and lead follow-up remotely.
intro: Build a practical advertising plan for customers in Saudi Arabia, with a clear role for each channel and a review process for language, creative and lead follow-up. Zainab Abdullah works remotely with business owners and their teams.
sections: Start with the Saudi audience you can serve

Clarify whether you need enquiries from Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam or a wider delivery area. A single country-level audience may hide different service coverage, delivery times and customer needs. The campaign brief should define the product, customer, purchase route and any geographic exclusions before a budget is distributed.
Arabic and English need a review workflow

Audience language, landing-page language and ad creative should form one coherent journey. Where Arabic assets are required, agree on who supplies or reviews the wording and its cultural suitability before launch. Arabic translation or native-language copywriting is not assumed to be included. English-language campaign management can be coordinated with the business’s approved local reviewers.
Plan seasonal campaigns before the deadline

If an offer is tied to Ramadan, Eid or another Saudi trading period, work backwards from the campaign dates to stock availability, creative approvals and landing-page readiness. Promotional claims and any sector-specific requirements need approval from the business. A planning calendar helps prevent last-minute creative changes from replacing a useful test.
Connect ads with a useful sales conversation

If your team sells through WhatsApp, a website or booked consultations, agree what qualifies an enquiry and who responds to it. Media budgets can be planned in SAR with a separate management fee. Riyadh-time reporting and approval windows are confirmed in the scope; no response-hour coverage is assumed before agreement.
questions: Arabic copy or translation is scoped explicitly with an agreed reviewer. Do not assume native Arabic production is included in paid ads management.
Can a campaign focus on one Saudi city?
The brief can focus on the cities or service areas your business covers. Final targeting options depend on the advertising platform and account eligibility.

name: Kuwait
label: Kuwait
title: Paid Ads Management for Kuwait Businesses
description: Remote Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Google Ads support for Kuwait businesses. Plan KWD budgets, service coverage, creative tests and enquiry follow-up.
intro: Turn your Kuwait business goals into a focused campaign brief: who you serve, what makes the offer relevant and how an enquiry becomes a sale. Work remotely with Zainab Abdullah on paid advertising and supporting content.
sections: Make coverage part of the campaign plan

Confirm the governorates, delivery areas or appointment locations your business can support. A campaign for an online store with delivery restrictions needs a different customer journey from a service that requires an in-person visit. Put opening hours, booking availability and delivery expectations on the landing page so the ad promise matches what the team can fulfil.
Set a test budget that matches the offer

Define the KWD media budget separately from management fees and creative production. Prioritise one clear conversion goal and a small number of meaningful creative hypotheses. If the budget cannot support simultaneous tests across Meta, TikTok and Google, select the first channel from the available evidence rather than spreading activity across every account.
Prepare language and mobile handoffs

Decide whether customers should see Arabic, English or separately approved creative variants. Make sure the destination page answers the same offer and price questions as the ad. If WhatsApp is part of the journey, the business needs an owner for incoming conversations and a process for recording whether each enquiry was relevant. Native Arabic production is agreed separately when required.
Report on quality and the next decision

Define what a successful order, appointment or qualified enquiry looks like before launch. Reports should connect spend and conversions with your team’s lead-quality feedback and identify the next test. Kuwait-time approval windows and the reporting currency are confirmed during scoping. Short-term results are interpreted in the context of the offer and available data.
questions: Is advertising spend included in your fee?
No. Advertising platform spend, management fees and additional creative work are agreed separately. Share your planned KWD media budget so the proposed scope is realistic.
Can you help with WhatsApp enquiry campaigns?
The sales handoff can be included in campaign planning. Platform options, tracking and your team’s follow-up process are reviewed before a campaign type is selected.

name: Qatar
label: Qatar
title: Paid Ads Management for Qatar Businesses
description: Meta, TikTok and Google Ads planning for Qatar businesses. Remote campaign support with QAR budgets, audience research and appointment or sales measurement.
intro: Build campaigns around the customers your Qatar business is ready to serve. Zainab Abdullah offers remote paid advertising support, with a psychology perspective on messaging and a business analyst’s attention to the enquiry journey.
sections: Define the offer and fulfilment area

For a Doha-based service or a business serving wider Qatar, the first decision is the actual service area and capacity. Specify whether customers book appointments, request quotes, visit a location or buy online. The landing page should explain the offer, availability and next step clearly enough for a customer to decide whether to enquire.
Use customer segments with a clear purpose

Different products may need different creative, language and landing-page information. Start with customer needs and business relevance rather than assuming one audience or language fits everyone. Arabic assets require an agreed approval process, and any translation is scoped explicitly. The initial channel is selected from the goal, existing demand and the creative you can produce.
Keep appointment campaigns connected to capacity

A booking-focused campaign needs current availability, a clear confirmation process and a way to record attended or qualified appointments. If the sales team prefers WhatsApp, agree who owns the conversation and how outcomes are recorded. The campaign plan should reflect fulfilment capacity so advertising does not create enquiries your team cannot handle.
Agree the reporting and approval routine

Plan media spend in QAR, confirm management fees separately and identify the person who approves creative. Set Doha-time meeting and feedback windows before launch. Reports should distinguish platform conversions from confirmed enquiries or sales where the available data permits. Expansion into another channel follows the evidence from the initial scope.
questions: Can I hire you remotely from Qatar?
Yes. Work is scoped for remote collaboration, with agreed approval, meeting and reporting arrangements. This is not a claim of a physical Qatar office.
Which advertising platform should I start with?
Share your offer, audience, website, QAR budget and available creative. The recommendation depends on customer intent and the conversion journey; no single platform is the default for every business.
